sources.quote: As founders and operators, we’ve been in your shoes. We partner with and invest in early-stage founders building infrastructure and SaaS companies. We started Vertex US from a desire to pay it forward We saw the positive impact of high-conviction and highly present investors when we were building our companies, so we founded Vertex US to do the same. Our special power is partnering with technical founders to nail the go-to-market and assemble exceptional teams. We’ll share lessons learned from our journeys as company builders and bring curiosity and candor to every step. "I remember meeting Vertex for the first time[...] I instantly felt a bit more comfortable because they were founders, and so I didn't feel like I had to put on a suit and tie and do the investor dance. I felt like I could talk about product, I could talk about the value that we're bringing to our customers and even ask questions, get mentored. I think that was what made me choose Vertex at the end of the day when we had multiple term sheets. There's a lot of money in Silicon Valley, but former founders who've seen the movie once or twice, and then seen it at the scale that the Vertex team has seen it, is very rare.
